headline: Anthropic IPO Filing Reports $16.3 Billion in Half-Year Revenue
deck: The filing reported $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and an $80.7 billion net loss as Anthropic pursues an initial public offering.
body: Anthropic filed for an initial public offering Monday. TechCrunch reported that the company plans to list under the ticker ANT and recorded $16.3 billion in revenue for the first half of 2026, up from $1.2 billion in the same period a year earlier. [E1] [E3]
Its net loss for the half was $80.7 billion, which TechCrunch reported was largely driven by noncash accounting adjustments tied to convertible debt. [E2]
CNN reported that the filing could become one of the largest stock-market debuts. [E3]
